project_info.theme: Desk snack moment with black glutinous rice yogurt
project_info.color_palette: Lavender purple, white, soft gray, deep violet

main_subject.detail: A top-down/angled desk lifestyle composition featuring three Vinamilk 'NẾP CẨM' yogurt cups on a white tabletop. One open cup shows black glutinous rice topping in a spoon. A purple label says 'NẾP CẨM DẺO THƠM'. Around the product are a lavender mechanical keyboard, desktop monitor edge, notebooks, pencil, and striped stationery.
main_subject.style: Soft aesthetic productivity-lifestyle product shot with cohesive purple art direction
